text: I want an infographic of ice cream sales, as a bar chart made of shapes.
Y axis: a thin black rectangle, 4 wide and 330 tall, at 100,255. Call it AxisY.
X axis: black rectangle 560 x 4 at 380,440, named AxisX
Jan bar: rectangle 60 wide, 100 tall, at 160,370, named Jan
Feb: 60 by 150 rectangle at 260,345, Feb
March is a 60 by 200 rectangle at 360,320 called Mar
Apr, a 60 by 250 rectangle, at 460,295
and May, the peak: 60 by 300 rectangle centred at 560,270
Paint Jan blue, Feb teal, Mar green, Apr orange and May red
write the values on the bars: Jan "120"
Apr gets "350" and May "400"
Month names under the axis: small text "Jan" at 160,458
then small "Feb" at 260,458, small "Mar" at 360,458
small "Apr" at 460,458 and small "May" at 560,458
Big title at 310,60: "Ice cream sales 2026", navy, huge
Is May bigger than Apr?
which bar is the biggest?
Add a gold star named Best 20 px above May
dashed arrow from Jan to May labeled "growing!"
make that arrow orange
Now a June bar too: 60 by 260 rectangle named Jun right of May, 40 px gap
paint Jun magenta
move Jun down 20 so its bottom lines up with the others
label Jun "330"
write "Jun" under it, small, at 660,458
how many rectangles are there now, axes included?
List the red shapes.
Put a small gray circle in the top left as a logo, call it Logo
Text "units sold, thousands", small and gray, at 200,110
Which shape is closest to Best?
group the six bars as Bars
move the title 10 px up
Is Jun right of May?
Move Best 40 px to the right
Take the arrow from Jan to May away, it's too busy
What color is Mar?
Change Mar to lime
hmm, no, green was better. Undo.
delete Logo
describe Jun
Nice chart!
